notes.title: FISH³ is casting it's line for Steam Fishing Fest! + Demo 1.10 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hey anglers and fishes, 
I'm excited to announce that FISH³ is going to be part of Steam Fishing Fest starting Jun 16th until June 23rd!! Remember to wishlist the game and leave a review on the Demo! It helps with visibility, and directly supports development. 
And with that, we have updated the demo to version 1.12 featuring many gameplay improvements, fixes, and most importantly - stats and achievements!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45588963/6701313254011bc32a8260e36e3ae33766fb43b8.png"]

Major Changes since 1.0:

Stage Stats: Each stage will now store it's own stats - Best Time and Best Score. 

Achievements: There's now 8 achievements in the Demo!

Tutorial extended: you can freely practice after you finish the tutorial course.

Full controller support + Linux & SteamOS Build. It's playable on Steam Deck!

Changed save file formatting to JSON. It will be rewritten from the old save file automatically.

Fixes:

Fixed some cases where fishing process can be interrupted (There still is an issue with Pausing during casting animation).

Fixed resolutions support.

Fishing zone speed readjusted to match player speed more.

In-air behaviour improved. Ramps are more stable now.

Some more smaller fixes that I didn't write down.



More updates coming this week, stay tuna'd! The game is in active development so even if there's issues now, We will be doing our best for resolving them!

You can follow development on Twitter and Bluesky. 

Happy fishing!
